name: Ban'ethil Hollow
summary: South of the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus, furbolgs threaten travelers in Ban'ethil Hollow. The ravine also hides the entrance to Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

sections.title: A Perilous Ravine
sections.body: Furbolgs roam the rocky descent into Ban'ethil Hollow. Their strange affliction has driven them mad, and they stalk the nearby road, ambushing couriers and wandering sentinels. The hollow lies just south of the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus, a reminder that Teldrassil's woodland is not wholly safe. At the ravine's back stands the entrance to Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Slumbering druids and ancient tunnels lie within, threatened by the maddened beasts outside.

faq.answer: Ban'ethil Hollow is a ravine in central Teldrassil, just south of the main road between Dolanaar and Darnassus.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs here hostile?
faq.answer: A spreading corruption and madness grips the World Tree's wildlife, turning the furbolgs across Teldrassil fiercely territorial and violent. They once lived peacefully alongside the night elves.

faq.q: What is inside the Ban'ethil Barrow Den at the back of the hollow?
aliases: what is in the barrow den
faq.answer: Ban'ethil Barrow Den is an underground complex where night elven druids have long entered deep hibernation and communed with the Emerald Dream. Rising corruption in the hollow has made the den dangerous ground.

faq.q: Is the road above the hollow safe to travel?
faq.answer: Night elf sentinels patrol the main road, but furbolgs from Ban'ethil Hollow often climb up to ambush travelers. Stay alert on the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see furbolgs falling to madness near the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus, a grim sign of Teldrassil's growing sickness. Young sentinels and druids must step in.
As a druid, you know Ban'ethil Hollow hides the entrance to Ban'ethil Barrow Den, sacred ground where druids rest and commune with the Emerald Dream. Rabid wildlife now threatens it.
